title: Cosmic expansion is the expansion of the temporal flow

statements.text: The expansion scalar $\Theta = \nabla_\mu u^\mu$ of the flow governs density along it: where the congruence expands, temporal density falls. Large-scale cosmic expansion is that same expansion on the homogeneous background.

sources.quote: If Θ > 0, the congruence expands and the density decreases along the flow.
Equation (37) states that cosmological density evolution is controlled by expansion of the congruence and the effective enthalpy ρt + pt .
